My Process

Discover

Sit with the brief until the real problem surfaces, not just the stated one.

start messy, on purpose

Research

Interviews, surveys, and quiet observation — the notebook fills up fast here.

listen more than ask

Wireframe

Rough boxes and arrows before anything gets to look pretty.

ugly first, always

UI Design

Type, colour, and spacing get deliberate once the structure is proven.

details, quietly

Prototype

Click-through flows that feel real enough to break.

make it feel real

Testing

Watch people use it before believing it works.

watch, don't explain

Launch

Ship, measure, and keep the notebook open for the next round.

the notebook never closes
